description: Ezekiel lived mostly silent for years, then God gave him his voice back the night before the news arrived. God has the timing of the whole thing in His hand.
excerpt: Ezekiel didn't get a timeline. He just kept walking in obedience, and then one evening God moved. He had the timing of the whole thing in His hand the entire time.
verse: "The previous evening the Lord had taken hold of me and given me back my voice. So I was able to speak when this man arrived the next morning."
body_html:
Can you even imagine?

I can't. That's actually why I highlighted this verse.

Years earlier, in Ezekiel 3, God told him he wouldn't be able to speak at all except when God Himself gave him a word to deliver. So for years, Ezekiel lived mostly silent. He opened his mouth only when God loosed his tongue for a specific message. Think about what that would do to a person, to your family, to your ministry, to your sense of normal.

Then the night before a messenger shows up to tell him Jerusalem has fallen, God gives him his voice back. Just like that. Years of silence lifted in a moment.

I can't wrap my head around what that would feel like. All those years of waiting, of obeying when every part of you probably wanted to speak, of showing up each day not knowing when or if God was going to loose your tongue again.

Ezekiel didn't get a timeline. He didn't know this would be the night. He just kept walking in obedience, and then one evening God moved.

Most of us are walking through something God hasn't moved on yet, like a relationship He hasn't restored, a door He hasn't opened, a prayer He hasn't answered, or a silence we don't understand. It's easy to start thinking the silence is permanent, that this is just how it's going to be from now on.

Ezekiel's story says otherwise. God knew the exact evening He was going to speak. He knew the exact day the news was coming. He had the timing of the whole thing in His hand the entire time, even when Ezekiel couldn't see it.

He knows yours too.

What has God been silent about in your life, and are you still trusting Him with the timing of when He'll move?
question: What has God been silent about in your life, and are you still trusting Him with the timing of when He'll move?
